[[File:Dweezel.jpg|250px|thumb|A plate of dweezel]]
'''Dweezel''' was a gooey pastry common to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They were invented by the [[Chef/Legends|culinary genius]] [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Umlaut]]. Ingredients of dweezel consisted of [[Bread/Legends|dough]], a [[Berry/Legends|berry]] filling, a starchy filling of [[Tuber/Legends|tubers]], and a [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] glaze. An [[Ice cream/Legends|ice cream]] [[Gender/Legends|man]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] was known to have a plate of dweezel in his possession.
